status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 114% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 114 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces continue to hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and opposition fighters have seized a third town in a week, intensifying fighting in the Bay region. Ethiopia is reported to be supporting al-Shabab militants in the Southwest State and is planning a troop withdrawal from Somalia as fighting intensifies at home. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is deepening defence ties with Pakistan by agreeing to acquire JF-17 fighter jets. Four Pakistani sailors freed from pirates are being moved to a Somali city, and the conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene fortsetter å holde korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har tatt Buurhakaba og opposisjonskrigere har erobret en tredje by i løpet av en uke, noe som intensiverer kampene i Bay-regionen. Etiopia skal etter rapporter støtte al-Shabab-militante i Southwest State og planlegger en tilbaketrekning av tropper fra Somalia ettersom kampene intensiveres hjemme. Somalia screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og styrker forsvarsbåndene med Pakistan ved å bli enige om å anskaffe JF‑17‑jagerfly. Fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra pirater, blir flyttet til en somalisk by, og konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
